descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B04 · P0 · 新

一次不含体征的 pre-round Save Note，会把昨天的血压、肌酐、一次性给药重新打上今天的时间（「Given · Oct 13」变成今天），旧数值被当成今天的，也永远不过期

票：TFA-92588 ready for pr；TFA-92597 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

注：要在 PR #100/#101 分支上复测，看是否已修

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-19/S12

思路 / Approach · OAT-04 Data Retention · S12 「「最后刷新」= 新值：没有新值的保存不会重启 36 h 时钟」 'Last refreshed' = a new value: saves without a new value do not restart the 36 h clock

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T1 'Last refreshed' for vitals, labs and imaging means a new value was recorded: saving (pre-round Save Note, a panel save, Generate) without a new value does not restart their 36 h clock. …（TFA-94699 AC 2） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U4 Hospital vitals, labs and imaging are deleted 36 h after they were last refreshed: a vital and a lab not refreshed for 37 h are gone.（UAT OAT-04 (B)；UAT OAT-04 step 1；UAT 3.6；UAT 3.7；TFA-94699 AC 1 (table: vitals, labs, imaging 36 h)） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress

测试设计方法：状态迁移（state-transition） — 按先后顺序走（加 → 改 → 删、第 1 天 → 第 2 天、离线 → 在线），每一步之后看状态对不对。

Given Two Hospital patients with BP 136/84, Cr 1.3 and the imaging line 'CXR: no infiltrate' recorded at T0 (aging helper)

When At T0+24 h on patient 1: a pre-round Save Note whose text has no vitals, labs or imaging, the Vitals, Labs and Imaging panels opened and saved unchanged, and a Generate. On patient 2: the same, plus a new BP 128/80 recorded. Then age both to T0+37 h and purge

Then Patient 1: BP, Cr and the CXR line gone at T0+37 h (their clock never moved). Patient 2: the new BP stays until T0+24+36 h; Cr and the CXR line, not re-recorded, are gone at T0+37 h

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94699 AC 2 (T1, vitals / labs / imaging) and UAT 3.7 ('cleared 36 h after last refreshed'): a value that survives T0+37 h only because of a save without a new value = Fail; whether a re-dictated identical value counts is Q5

在哪跑：本地 retention（改时钟看保留期）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 人工（blocked）

S12 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-04.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94699 in progress

医生一直在用，昨天的生命体征和化验就永远不过期：一条不含体征和化验的预查房 Save Note 会把昨天的血压、肌酐用新时间重新记一遍（还多出一行重复的「Creatinine 1.3」），面板不改直接保存也会重置 36 小时计时。

Yesterday's vitals and labs never age out while the physician keeps working: a pre-round Save Note with no vitals or labs in it re-records yesterday's BP and creatinine with a fresh clock (adding a duplicate 'Creatinine 1.3' row), and saving a panel unchanged also restarts its 36 h clock.

依据：allure ac6b8d0a-…-result.json; retention lane (backend log convex-5910.log lines 77-86). 1 check passes, 9 fail: 4 known (K8, unchanged panel saves), 5 not in the matrix knownGaps. The new part is the Save Note echo: usePreRoundProcess sends the values on file as context and writes back whatever the model returns. It is intermittent (live AI): 2/2 charts in this run, 3/4 and 2/4 in earlier runs. It is not in the dev report or ledger. Breaks TFA-94699 AC 2 and UAT 3.7. The Generate leg was not run (Generate is forbidden locally).

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane retention。
